summary: This tutorial explains how to customize slide backgrounds and designs in LibreOffice Impress on GNU/Linux. It covers selecting and applying custom backgrounds, modifying master slides, and adding design elements like shapes and logos. To apply a custom background, open a sample presentation, then use the Slide Master option to edit the master slide. This changes the background for all slides. For text clarity, choose a contrasting color. To add shapes, use the Basic Shapes toolbar to draw rectangles, circles, and other shapes. These can be resized and positioned using the handles or control points. The tutorial also demonstrates adding a logo and adjusting its position on the slide. Overall, it guides users through creating consistent and visually appealing presentations in LibreOffice Impress.
